title: Le Pen stands by top ally Bardella as anti-Semitism claims hit star of French far right
summary: French far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen has reiterated her "complete confidence" in National Rally (RN) leader Jordan Bardella, accused by investigative news outlet Mediapart of making anti-Semitic comments in 2013.
